title: 第13章 杀人
content_zh:
第13章 杀人
李叶盛去年死了父亲，家里的田地和财物都归了他这个长子所有，他真是好不快意，连忙卖了一块地换了些钱，在村里的小铺里痛痛快快地吃起来。
此后三天两头无所事事，就在村里和山上晃悠，更加肆无忌惮地调戏偷窃，整个黎泾村除了大伯李木田，他谁也不怵，谁也不怕。
可怜了幼弟李叶生，明明和李项平一般大的年纪，李项平从小就在村头跟着先生读书，而他李叶生却孤苦伶仃、饥寒交迫。
十几岁大的孩子，才失去了父亲，日日要放鸭又要替人看牛，要不是李木田家时时帮衬，恐怕早就饿死在家中了。
李叶盛哪管他生死，闲下来时心中总是痒痒着，看着李长湖一家出入青砖砌成的大院，嫉妒地发狂。
“大家都姓李，凭什么你嫡我庶，凭什么你买了良田盖了高院！不过一个村里的大户，学什么派头来建大院？好像院里有多少宝贝似的！”
他骤然直起身，恍然大悟地想起几年前的夜晚，几人紧张的神色和李木田手中的刀。
“李木田有宝贝啊……”
李叶盛叼着狗尾巴草，望着田上笑着与租户交谈的李长湖，心中暗暗不爽。
“妈呀！”
夜色已晚，山间高猿长啸，豺吠狼嚎，凉风从李叶盛的裤衩子底下穿过，冻得他双腿一夹，一屁股坐在大石头上。
“大哥，你觉得我们四人中何人最像父亲？”李通崖突然开口，很是认真地盯着大哥李长湖。
“通崖，你可着手准备凝聚玄景轮了？”李长湖双手按压在木桌上，带着点羡慕地问着。
颤颤巍巍地冒头一看，这人眉眼清秀，低眉望着自己，竟是自己的堂弟李项平。
嫌弃地退了一步，李项平眼看着李叶盛的尸体倒下，思忖了一会儿，又掐诀施法，唤出一道金芒。
“再过几天便可凝聚八十一缕月华，我等远不如尺泾，总觉得要再等等，多准备几日。”
他的眼前浮现起一道璀璨的金芒，咽喉处一阵剧痛，眼前的世界天旋地转，一会儿望见亮盈盈的明月，一会儿又看见月光下模糊的小院。
李叶盛又坐了半刻钟，冻得清水鼻涕直流，心中也默默编排好了准备散布在村中的流言：
“为何？”李长湖疑惑着望着弟弟。

李通崖笑着取过一小段白布，在木简上用力缠绕几圈，打了个活结。
什么祖上传下来的宝贝，他李叶盛也是李家的，怎么分不到一份？要是武功战法，他才懒得修，卖了换钱倒是能潇洒不少日子。
“不就投了个好胎么。”
“小时候在院中玩闹时，父亲曾说过：初杀人，或耳鸣头热，进退失据，或颤颤巍巍，不能自己，或咆哮不止，不知天地为何物。”
“还挺邪乎。”
李长湖脱口而出，旋即愣了愣，寻了处位置坐下，又笑着继续说：
“我太宽和，项平太好动，尺泾太腼腆，唯独你李通崖镇定自若，不动声色，最是像他。”
在树荫下小睡了一会儿，眼看着夜色深了，李叶盛“呸”地吐掉口中的狗尾巴草，挽起裤腿，悄悄摸摸地往李家大院潜去。
李叶盛双眼一瞪，摆出蛮横的姿态，正欲发作，却望见李项平手中掐了个诀。
大黎山曲折绵延，黎泾村的后山只是其中一峰，村民懒得取名，就唤作后山。
————
“洗手去了。”
李通崖慢悠悠地卷好木简，看着大哥开口道。
“什么？”
李通崖干笑了几声，摆了摆手正色道：
“大哥休要吹捧我了，依我看，我们四兄弟中，项平最像他。”
他蹲下身子，按照合适的比例噗嗤噗嗤地将其尸体切成大段，好叫夜间闻着味道来的野兽们带到山间的不同地方。
李叶盛的脑袋骤然飞起，重重地落在山间小径上，他残留的意识疑惑地看着李项平脸上冷冰冰的笑容，只觉得这个堂弟前所未有的陌生。
低头望望院中，已经一个人影也没有了，李叶盛也没在意，紧了紧袖口就站起身准备回家。
翻过后山往南去便是眉尺峰，再往南到山下就是泾阳村，两村互通有无便是从山间的小路走。

李长湖从入定中醒来，却不见两个弟弟，偌大后院静得只剩虫鸣。他心中疑惑，连忙跨步到了正院，这才见到了李通崖。
做完这一切，李项平站起身望了望四周，林子间的阴影处已经多了不少绿油油的眼睛，李项平拍了拍手，低声道：
“诸君慢用。”
李叶盛往墙上吐了口唾沫，发了狠劲，拔腿向后山奔去。
李叶盛拨开树丛，沿着小路爬了半刻钟，在山中寻了一处突出视野开阔处，伏下身子望向山下的小院。
望着坐在木桌前翻看法诀的李通崖，李长湖有些疑惑地问道：
“怎么不见项平。”
“听闻这东西院中摆了石锁，莫不是李木田在外头得了劳子武功战法，偷偷给那几个东西教去。”
他揉了揉眼睛，只见模模糊糊地几个人影晃动，像是在盘膝而坐，有人影抱着青石走来走去，不知在做甚。
李通崖缓缓开口道：
谁知一扭头，却见着山间小径上静静地站着个人影，吓得李叶盛屁滚尿流，连滚带爬地钻回了大青石背后。
“哈哈哈。”
“自然是你。”
“老子不信你们能在屋上立个罩。”
在院子周边绕了一圈，李叶盛连条墙缝都未曾看见，在墙上扒拉了几下，也砌的平整光滑，恐怕也难翻过去。
躲在石头背后的无头尸体脖颈处正噗噗地冒着血，热腾的血花染红了青石、土路、枯叶，一直流淌到李项平脚边。
“狗东西。”
李叶盛抬头望了望天，山间本就昏沉，明月又受乌云遮挡，大地一片乌黑，连人影也渐渐看不清了。
“唯独他李木田初杀人，收刀饮酒，谈笑自若。说完就哈哈大笑，得意非常。”
“项平最像父亲。”

李通崖压低声音，伏在李长湖耳边轻轻地道：
“是因为他足够残忍。”
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 13 Killing
Li Yesheng's father died last year, and the family's land and property were all owned by his eldest son. He was really unhappy, so he quickly sold a piece of land for some money and ate happily in a small shop in the village.
After that, he spent the next three days with nothing to do, just wandering around the village and the mountains, teasing and stealing even more brazenly. Except for his uncle Li Mutian, he was not afraid of anyone in the entire Lijing Village.
I feel sorry for my younger brother Li Yesheng. He is obviously the same age as Li Xiangping. Li Xiangping has been studying with his husband in the village since he was a child, but he, Li Yesheng, is lonely, hungry and cold.
The teenage boy had just lost his father. He had to herd ducks and look after cows every day. If the Li Mutian family hadn't always helped him, he would have starved to death at home.
Li Yesheng didn't care about his life or death. When he was free, he was always itching in his heart. He watched Li Changhu's family going in and out of the courtyard made of green bricks, and became crazy with jealousy.
"Everyone's surname is Li. Why are you my concubine? Why did you buy fertile land and build a high court! How can a wealthy family in a village learn how to build a high court? It seems like there are so many treasures in the court!"
He suddenly straightened up and suddenly remembered the night a few years ago, the nervous looks on several people's faces and the knife in Li Mutian's hand.
"Li Mutian has a baby..."
Li Yesheng held the dog's tail grass in his mouth and looked at Li Changhu who was smiling and talking to the tenants on the field, feeling secretly unhappy.
"Mom!"
It was getting late at night, the high apes in the mountains howled, the jackals howled and the wolves howled. The cool wind passed under Li Yesheng's pants, so cold that he clamped his legs and sat down on the big rock.
"Brother, who among the four of us do you think is most like his father?" Li Tongya suddenly spoke, staring at his eldest brother Li Changhu seriously.
"Tongya, are you ready to condense the Xuanjing Wheel?" Li Changhu pressed his hands on the wooden table and asked with a little envy.
He looked up tremblingly and saw that the man with delicate features and handsome eyes was looking at him with his eyebrows lowered. He turned out to be his cousin Li Xiangping.
Taking a step back in disgust, Li Xiangping watched Li Yesheng's body fall, thought for a while, and then cast a spell, summoning a golden light.
"In a few days, eighty-one rays of moonlight will be condensed. I can't wait as well as Chijing. I always feel that I have to wait a little longer and prepare for a few more days."
A bright golden light appeared in front of his eyes, and there was a sharp pain in his throat. The world in front of him was spinning. Sometimes he saw the bright moon, and sometimes he saw the blurry small courtyard under the moonlight.
Li Yesheng sat for another quarter of an hour, his nose dripping with cold water, and he silently prepared the rumors in his mind that he was going to spread in the village:
"Why?" Li Changhu looked at his brother in confusion.
Li Tongya smiled and took a small piece of white cloth, wrapped it around the wooden slip several times, and tied a slip knot.
What kind of treasure has been passed down from ancestors? He, Li Yesheng, also belongs to the Li family. Why can't he get a share? If it were martial arts and fighting techniques, he wouldn't be too lazy to practice them. If he sold them for money, he would be able to live comfortably for a long time.
"Isn't it just a good pregnancy?"
"When I was playing in the courtyard when I was a child, my father once said: When I first killed someone, my ears would ring in my ears and my head would be hot, I would be unable to advance or retreat, I would tremble and be unable to control myself, or I would roar incessantly and I would not know what the world is."
"It's quite evil."
Li Changhu blurted out, then froze for a moment, found a place to sit down, and continued with a smile:
"I'm too lenient, Xiang Ping is too active, and Chi Jing is too shy, but you, Li Tongya, are the only one who is calm and composed, most like him."
After taking a nap under the shade of a tree, seeing the night getting darker, Li Yesheng spat out the foxtail grass in his mouth, rolled up his trouser legs, and sneaked quietly into the Li family courtyard.
Li Yesheng's eyes widened and he assumed a arrogant posture. He was about to get angry when he saw Li Xiangping's hand holding a seal.
The Dali Mountains are winding and stretching, and the back mountain in Lijing Village is just one of the peaks. The villagers are too lazy to name it, so they call it the back mountain.
————
"Wash your hands."
Li Tongya slowly rolled up the wooden slips and watched his elder brother speak.road.
"What?"
Li Tongya laughed a few times, waved his hands and said seriously:
"Brother, please stop flattering me. In my opinion, among our four brothers, Xiang Ping is the most like him."
He knelt down and cut the body into large pieces according to appropriate proportions, so that the beasts that came at night could take them to different places in the mountains.
Li Yesheng's head suddenly flew up and landed heavily on the mountain path. His remaining consciousness looked at the cold smile on Li Xiangping's face with confusion, feeling that this cousin was stranger than ever before.
Looking down at the courtyard, there was no one left. Li Yesheng didn't care. He tightened his sleeves and stood up to go home.
Go over the back mountain and go south to Meichi Peak, and further south to the foot of the mountain is Jingyang Village. The two villages can be connected by taking the path between the mountains.
Li Changhu woke up from his trance, but his two younger brothers were missing. The huge backyard was so quiet that only the chirping of insects remained. He was confused and quickly walked to the main courtyard, where he saw Li Tongya.
After doing all this, Li Xiangping stood up and looked around. There were already many green eyes in the shadows of the woods. Li Xiangping clapped his hands and whispered:
"Please use it with caution."
Li Yesheng spat on the wall, worked hard, and ran towards the back mountain.
Li Yesheng pushed aside the bushes and climbed along the path for half a quarter of an hour. He found a place with a prominent view in the mountain and leaned down to look at the small courtyard at the foot of the mountain.
Looking at Li Tongya who was sitting at the wooden table and reading the formulas, Li Changhu asked with some confusion:
"Why don't you see Xiang Ping?"
"I heard that there are stone locks in the east and west courtyards. Could it be that Li Mutian learned Laozi's martial arts tactics outside and secretly taught them to those guys."
He rubbed his eyes and saw a few vague figures shaking around, as if they were sitting cross-legged, and a figure was walking around holding a bluestone, not knowing what they were doing.
Li Tongya slowly opened his mouth and said:
Unexpectedly, when he turned his head, he saw a figure standing quietly on the mountain path. Li Yesheng was so frightened that he urinated and crawled back behind the big bluestone.
"Hahaha."
"Of course it's you."
"I don't believe you can put up a cover on the house."
After walking around the yard, Li Yesheng didn't see even a crack in the wall. He pulled on the wall a few times and found that it was flat and smooth, so it might be difficult to climb over.
The headless corpse hiding behind the stone was bleeding from its neck. The hot blood dyed the bluestone, dirt road, and dead leaves red, and flowed all the way to Li Xiangping's feet.
"Shit."
Li Yesheng raised his head and looked at the sky. The mountains were already dark, and the bright moon was blocked by dark clouds. The earth was pitch black, and even the figures of people were gradually blurred.
"Li Mutian was the only one who killed people at the beginning, put away his knife, drank wine, and talked and laughed freely. After he finished speaking, he burst out laughing and was very proud."
"Xiang Ping is most like his father."
Li Tongya lowered his voice and whispered in Li Changhu's ear:
"Because he is cruel enough."
(End of chapter)
